source: 629 Corruption Removal
target: 629 Remotio Corruptionis

source: Madam Magician had not confirmed Lumian’s speculation or delved into the deeper truth of Hanth Island’s Demon legends.
target: Domina Magica speculationem Luminiani non confirmavit nec veritatem profundam fabularum daemonum Insulae Hanth perscrutata est.

source: Lumian realized that this likely involved something he shouldn’t pry into at the moment, or perhaps it was best not to understand until the accumulated corruption was eliminated.
target: Lumian intellexit hoc probabiliter implicare aliquid, in quo non oportuit eum interim explorare, aut fortasse melius erat non cognoscere, donec corruptio cumulata deleatur.

source: Does “find time” imply that I can go whenever I want, disregarding the healer’s schedule?
target: Num "tempus invenire" significat me posse ire quovis tempore, agenda curantis neglegendo?

source: Has Madam Magician foreseen that there won’t be any issues?
target: Num Domina Magica praevidit nullas difficultates futuras esse?

source: Lumian clutched the paper with the spirit world’s coordinates and activated the black mark on his right shoulder.
target: Lumian charta cum indicibus mundi spirituum prehendit et notam nigram in dextra humero suo activavit.

source: His figure vanished from the Berries, navigating through the swirling chaos of colors.
target: Figura eius ex Berries evanuit, per turbam colorum gyrantium navigans.

source: Occasionally, he felt inexplicable gazes and caught glimpses of indescribable forms.
target: Interdum sensit oculos inexplicabiles et conspexit species ineffabiles.

source: After an unknown period, Lumian arrived at the location corresponding to the spirit world’s coordinates and stepped out.
target: Post aliquod tempus ignotum, Lumian ad locum, qui indicibus mundi spirituum congruebatur, pervenit et exiit.

source: Before him stood a towering dome, illuminated by bright glass windows, with a mural depicting an epic scene.
target: Ante eum stabat cupola excelsa, claris vitrei fenestris illuminata, cum murale scaenam epicam depingentem.

source: In the midst of the hall, Lumian noticed a ball of sunlight.
target: In media aula, Lumian globum solis animadvertit.

source: Realization struck, prompting him to approach.
target: Repentina conscientia eum percussit, idque ad appropinquandum impulsit.

source: As he walked, the sunlight seemed to “spread” over, banishing shadows and darkness wherever it touched.
target: Dum ambulabat, solis lumen videbatur se diffundere, expulsans umbras et tenebras quotcumque attigeret.

source: Soon, Lumian found himself enveloped in the sunlight.
target: Mox, Lumian se in lumine solari involutum invenit.

source: Suddenly, it felt as if pure sunlight pierced through his skin, flesh, bones, and internal organs, exposing his soul.
target: Subito, videbatur quasi sol purus percuteret cutem eius, carnem, ossa atque visceras, animam eius revelans.

source: Bits of illusory black gas were expelled from his soul by the sunlight, portraying various of Lumian’s expressions–ferocious, pained, pleading, or intimidating.
target: Particulae gasi nigri illusorii ex anima eius a lumine solari expulsae sunt, diversas effigiæ Luminiani repraesentantes – feroces, dolentes, supplicantes, aut terribiles.

source: Within seconds, the black gas dissipated under the purifying sunlight.
target: Per paucos secundos, gas niger sub lumine purganti evanuit.

source: Simultaneously, Lumian felt his heart throb, and his left chest burned.
target: Simul, Lumian cor eius pulsare sensit, et pectus sinistrum ardere videbatur.

source: The blazing sunlight appeared to expel and purify everything in its path.
target: Lumen solis ardentis videbatur omnia in suo itinere expellere atque purgare.

source: Amidst the agonizing heartache, Lumian sensed a change in the seal on his left chest, as if it was concealing itself, synchronizing with the sunlight.
target: Inter dolorem cordis acri, Lumian mutationem in sigillo pectoris sinistri sensit, quasi ipse se celare conaretur, sole synchronice congruens.

source: However, before the attempt could fully succeed, the sunlight took the initiative to stop, receding like a tide into the depths of the hall.
target: Attamen, antequam conatus plene succederet, lumen solare inceptum cepit ut sisteret, revideret ut aestus in profundum aulae.

source: Lumian swiftly returned to his usual state. Aside from the lingering discomfort in his heart, he felt significantly more at ease, as if he had suddenly caught the morning breeze and glimpsed the sunrise after an extended period of oppressive darkness.
target: Lumian celeriter ad statum suum rediit. Praeter remanentem dolorem cordis, multo tranquillus se sensit, quasi subito flabra matutina cepisset et ortum solis post longum tempus opprimi tenebrarum intueretur.

source: His attention was drawn to a tall man in a simple white robe standing in the depths of the hall.
target: Attentio eius ad virum altum in veste alba simplici, qui in profundis aulae stabat, directa est.

source: Observing the man, Lumian estimated him to be around 22 or 23 years old, towering at over two meters with an imposing aura.
target: Observans virum, Lumian aestimavit eum annos XXII vel XXIII habere, plus quam duo metra altitudinis cum aspectu imponente praedito.

source: Despite his height, he exuded a calm temperament, and his brownish-yellow hair was neatly styled.
target: Non obstante altitudine, tranquillitatem animi efferebat, et capilli eius fusco‑flavi rite dispositi erant.

source: “The residual corruption on you has been cleared,” the tall man spoke in ancient Feysac.
target: "Corruptio residua in te expurgata est," vir altus in lingua antiqua Feysac locutus est.

source: Lumian had a suspicion and inquired, “Are you Mr. Sun?”
target: Lumian suspicatus est et interrogavit, "Esne Dominus Sol?"

source: “Yes,” the young and tall man responded politely, devoid of arrogance or impatience.
target: "Ita," respondit vir juvenis et altus comiter, carens superbia aut impatiens.

source: He’s actually so young, but one can’t judge his age from his appearance… Lumian expressed his gratitude without delving into further questions.
target: Revera, ille tam iuvenis est, sed ex specie eius aetatem iudicare non potest… Lumian gratiam suam expressit, ulteriora interroganda non faciens.

source: Indicating towards the hall’s exit, Lumian asked, “Can I go out for a walk?”
target: Exitu ad aulam indicans, Lumian rogavit, "Licetne mihi ambulare exire?"

source: Though unaware of his location, the murals suggested it was an essential cathedral of the Church of The Fool.
target: Quamquam locum suum ignorabat, picturae indicabant eam esse cathedralem essentialem Ecclesiae Stulti.

source: Lumian deduced that the Major Arcana card holder, The Sun, held a prominent position in the Church, or perhaps even the top position.
target: Lumian coniecerat tenentem tabulae Majoris Arcanae, Sol, locum praeclarum in Ecclesia habere, aut fortasse etiam supremum honoris locum.

source: “Sure.” Major Arcana The Sun nodded.
target: "Certe," annuit Majoris Arcana, Sol.

source: Observing the Church of The Fool’s etiquette, Lumian pressed his hand to his chest and bowed before turning to exit the hall.
target: Ecclesiae Stulti morem observans, Lumian manum ad pectum suum adpressit et inclinavit antequam aulam exire constituit.

source: Once outside, the world teemed with life. Voices and figures surrounded him.
target: Postquam exiit, mundus vita repleta erat. Voces et figuras eum circumdederunt.

source: His initial thought: Did I accidentally step into a land of giants?
target: Prima cogitatio eius: Num forte in terram gigantum casu ingressus sum?

source: The shortest individuals on the street were at least 1.89 meters tall, with occasional figures reaching three to four meters.
target: Minimi homines in via erant saltem 1.89 metra altitudinis, cum aliquando figurae ad tres aut quattuor metra pervenire videbantur.

source: Clad in white shirts, black trench coats, and half top hats, the men carried canes resembling spears, emitting an inexplicable sense of absurdity.
target: Induti tunicis albis, loricibus atris, et semi‑pileis, viri baculos similes telis gerebant, inexplicabilem sensum absurditatis emittens.

source: Even the ladies matched the towering height, mostly opting for flexibility in long pants rather than skirts.
target: Etiam mulieres altitudinem imponentem aequabant, plerumque longas bracas potius quam stolas praeferentes.

source: Lumian surveyed the area, his gaze traversing doors exceeding four meters in height.
target: Lumian circumspexit, oculis per ianuas plus quam quattuor metra alta peragrantes.

source: For a moment, he fell silent, feeling like a newborn in this peculiar environment.
target: Per momentum, silentium cepit, se quasi neonatum in hoc insolitum ambitu sentiens.

source: However, this realization only briefly dampened his mood for exploration.
target: Attamen, haec cognitio breviter animum eius ad explorationem afflixit.

source: Of course, it was only a brief moment.
target: Scilicet, solum momentum breve fuit.

source: Trier, Trocadéro, at the entrance of a grape manor.
target: Trier, Trocadéro, ad introitum villae uvarum.

source: Franca clarified to the valet that her purpose was to visit Madame Clarice, and he stepped aside without guiding her.
target: Franca servi declaravit propositum suum esse Madaminam Claricem visitare, et ille se recedens abiit sine ut eam duceret.

source: His stance implied that she knew the way and could proceed independently.
target: Habitus eius insinuabat eam viam scire et seipsam independenter pergere posse.

source: Undeterred, Franca followed the path ingrained in her memory, arriving at the circular pavilion nestled among the grape trees.
target: Intrepida, Franca viam in memoria insitam secuta est, ad pavilionem circularem inter arbores uvarum delatam perveniens.

source: Demoness of Black Clarice, adorned in a black court dress, was seated there.
target: Daemonissa Nigra Clarice, in veste atrā curiali ornata, ibi sedebat.

source: “Good morning, Your Excellency Clarice,” Franca greeted warmly, openly admiring her beautiful face and slightly sorrowful demeanor.
target: "Bonum mane, Clarice, Vestra Excellentia," Franca calide salutavit, aperte faciem eius pulcherrimam et modicum lugubrem habitum admirans.

source: Demoness of Black Clarice nodded slightly and inquired, “Has there been progress in the Mirror People investigation?”
target: Daemonissa Nigra Clarice leviter annuit et interrogavit, "Fuitne progressus in inquisitione Populi Specularis?"

source: Franca, not in a rush to respond, met Clarice’s dark‑gray eyes and remarked, “Is Browns not present?”
target: Franca, non festinans respondere, oculos Clarice obscuri‑cinerei convenit et dixit, "Nonne adest Browns?"

source: “She’s not my lady’s maid. She attends to her own matters,” Demoness of Black Clarice replied succinctly.
target: "Non est ancilla dominae meae. Suis rebus operatur," daemonissa Nigra Clarice breviter respondit.

source: “Not at the Red House Café or the hunting ground beside the forest either,” Franca observed the air’s fragrance and chose to engage in conversation with the Demoness of Black.
target: "Ne in Caffenea Domus Rubrae neque in venatione iuxta silvam," Franca odorem aeris observavit et elegit cum daemonissa Nigra colloqui.

source: “She has other matters to attend to,” Clarice evaded delving into Browns’ affairs.
target: "Alia negotia habet curanda," Clarice evasit in rebus Browns investigandis.

source: Reluctantly, Franca recounted the details of the Minister of Industry, Moran Avigny’s situation, from the initial sensing of the Mirror World Fragment’s tremors after the play, substituting herself as the person involved.
target: Dole, Franca enarravit singula de re Ministri Industriae, Moran Avigny, ex initio sensu tremorum Fragmenti Mundi Specularis post ludum, se substituens in persona implicata.

source: Clarice remained silent, her eyes lowered in contemplation.
target: Clarice silentium tenuit, oculis in meditatione demissis.

source: Franca didn’t rush the Demoness of Black. Her gaze flickered between the deep gray of her eyes, the fairness of her delicate skin, the curves that stirred the soul, and the unnaturally alluring red lips.
target: Franca daemonissam Nigram non festinavit. Oculi eius inter obscurum cinereum oculorum, candidam cutem delicatam, lineas animam excitantes, et labra rubea insolitum allicientes micabantur.

source: She knew this wasn’t a good idea, but she couldn’t rein in her impulses. Her heart gradually heated up, and her thoughts got a bit muddled. Her mouth dried, forcing her to purse her lips intermittently.
target: Sciebat hoc non esse bonum consilium, sed impulsus suos reprimere non poterat. Cor eius paulatim calefaciebatur, et cogitationes in turbationem redactae erant. Os eius siccum factum est, compelens eam ut intermissionibus labra contraheret.

source: Dammit! Why am I feeling this way right now?
target: Heu! Cur hoc modo me nunc sentio?

source: While humans as animals can be susceptible to instincts, I’ve always maintained composure during serious discussions and encounters with high‑ranking figures.
target: Dum homines, ut animalia, instinti susceptibiles sunt, ego semper constantiam servavi in gravibus disputationibus et congressionibus cum personis summi gradus.

source: At most, I’ve held admiration… Could it be that the Demoness of Black is intentionally radiating her charm to draw me in? Or is there another explanation?
target: Maxime, solum admirationem feci... Num daemonissa Nigra conscie suam venustatem radiare censet ut me attrahat? An alia ratio existit?

source: Yes, the lingering corruption from the Demon incident must be affecting me! Though it’s subtle and doesn’t manifest in my daily life, it’s making it difficult for me to control my desires in the presence of a high‑ranking Demoness known for her feminine allure. As a result, I find myself slipping into an aroused state…
target: Ita, residua corruptio ex incidente daemonum me afficere debet! Quamquam subtilis est et in vita cotidiana non manifestatur, difficile mihi reddit cupiditates meas regere in praesentia daemonissae summi gradus, nota ob venustatem feminam. Quam ob rem, me in statum excitatum labentem invenio...

source: Franca gritted her teeth, refusing to succumb to the temptations of desire.
target: Franca dentes stridens, tentationibus desiderii se tradere recusavit.

source: Clarice looked up at her.
target: Clarice ad eam respexit.

source: “Has it been too long since you’ve experienced pleasure?”
target: "Num diu praeteriit ex quo voluptatem percepisti?"

source: “Not since my last lover passed away,” Franca replied truthfully, aware that the Demoness of Black referred to a specific kind of pleasure.
target: "Non, ex quo ultimus amator meus mortuus est," Franca veraciter respondit, conscius quod daemonissa Nigra ad speciem voluptatis specialem referret.

source: She explained, “As I mentioned earlier, to get close to Moran Avigny’s illegitimate daughter, I used a mystical item. Unfortunately, it had a side effect, leading to encounters with Demons and other evil entities for a transaction. I was somewhat affected.”
target: Explicavit, "Ut ante dixi, ad accedendum ad filiam illegitimam Moran Avigny, rem mysticam usus sum. Infeliciter, ei effectus secundarius fuit, qui ad congressus cum daemonibus aliisque maleficis entitatibus pro transactione duxit. Paullo affecta fui."

source: Clarice’s voice turned icy.
target: Vox Clarice glaciali facta est.

source: “Endurance is not a sustainable solution. Indulge yourself. Otherwise, the Demon pathway will become your nemesis.”
target: "Patientia non est solutio sustinenda. Te indulge. Alioquin via daemonum tibi inimicus fiet."

source: The Demoness of Black’s aura instantly shifted to a holy and dignified state, becoming inviolable.
target: Aura daemonissae Nigrae statim in sanctam et dignam conditionem mutata est, inviolabile facta.

source: Franca also sensed that she couldn’t entertain lascivious thoughts about such a captivating beauty.
target: Franca quoque sensit se non posse cogitationes lascivias de tam captivante pulchritudine tenere.

source: Her desires gradually subsided, and her mind cleared, breaking free from her aroused state.
target: Desideria eius paulatim minuuntur, et mens eius purgata est, a statu excitatum liberata.

source: Clarice redirected the conversation.
target: Clarice sermonem redirexit.

source: “You aim to deal with Moran Avigny?”
target: "Visne te agere de Moran Avigny?"

source: “He should be a crucial Mirror Person. If we can capture him or channel his spirit, we should uncover most of the Mirror People hidden in Trier. Madame, I seek your assistance,” Franca stated, laying out her thoughts.
target: "Is maxime momenti persona specularis esse debet. Si eum capere aut spiritum eius adducere possimus, pleraque Populi Specularis in Trier latentis detegere debemus. Domina, auxilium tuum quaero," Franca enuntiavit.

source: She avoided mentioning that Moran Avigny shared Clarice’s dark‑gray eyes and instead presented a color photo.
target: Ea vitavit fateri quod Moran Avigny oculos Clarice cinereos obscuros haberet, sed potius imaginem coloratam exhibuit.

source: Clarice nodded slightly and said, “You can now strategize your operation. I’ll assist during crucial moments, but for most scenarios, you must rely on yourself and the factions under your control.”
target: Clarice leviter annuit et dixit, "Nunc consilium operationis tuae excogitare potes. Ego in momentis clavibus adiuvabo, sed in plurimis casibus in teipso et in factionibus sub tua potestate confidere debes."

source: “No problem.” Franca didn’t conceal her excitement.
target: "Nulla quaestio." Franca eius laetitiam non celavit.

source: As she exited the vine‑surrounded circular pavilion, Demoness of Black Clarice’s dark‑gray eyes turned cold as she rose slowly.
target: Exitu ex pavilionem circularem vineis circumdatum, oculi daemonissae Nigrae Clarice obscuri‑cinerei frigidi facti sunt, dum lente surrexit.

source: In a brightly lit bar, Lumian clinked a beer glass, larger than his head, against the nearly three‑meter‑tall “giant” opposite him and gulped down the golden liquor.
target: In taberna lucide illustrata, Lumian poculum cerevisiae, maius quam caput eius, contra "gigantem" paene trium metrorum altitudinis, qui adversus eum stabat, percussit et liquorem aureum ingurgitavit.

source: Wiping the corners of his mouth, he chuckled.
target: Angulos oris sui abstergens, risit.

source: “So, this is the New City of Silver in the Bible.”
target: "Ita, haec est Nova Urbs Argentea in Biblia."

source: From the sermons he had heard, Lumian knew that the New City of Silver served as the headquarters of the Church of The Fool, situated in the Sonia Sea.
target: Ex sermonibus quibus audierat, Lumian scivit Novam Urbem Argenteam esse sedem Ecclesiae Stulti, in Mari Sonia sita.

source: It had been established by the surviving humans rescued by Gehrman Sparrow from the cursed continent of the Forsaken Land of the Gods.
target: Ea constituta erat ab humanis superstitis a Gehrman Sparrow excussis ex continente maledicto Terrae Abiectarum Deorum.

source: Unexpectedly, the surviving humans were towering figures, almost like giants!
target: Inopinanter, homines superstites personae imponentes erant, paene ut gigantes!

source: “That’s right. All the warriors here are ready to defend Mr. Fool’s Church at all times!” the nearly three‑meter‑tall giant expressed with satisfaction.
target: "Recte." inquit gigantus paene trium metrorum altitudinis, "Omnes bellatores hic semper parati sunt Ecclesiam Domini Stulti defendere!"

source: “You’re not bad. You worship the Angel of Redemption and believe in Mr. Fool. Just these two points alone makes us brothers!”
target: "Non es malus. Angelum Redemptoris colis et in Domine Stulto credis. Haec duo tantum nos fratres faciunt!"

source: He extended his right palm and slapped Lumian, nearly toppling him. It felt like a child encountering a brown bear’s paw.
target: Manum dexteram extendit et Luminian percussit, fere illum corruperet. Simi similis fuit sensus, quasi puer manum ursi fusci contingens.

source: Lumian forced a smile and inquired, “Can you share more about the Angel of Redemption’s deeds in the Forsaken Land of the Gods?”
target: Lumian risum fingit et interrogavit, "Potesne amplius narrare de factis Angeli Redemptoris in Terra Abiecta Deorum?"
